correctness.rationale: For any projective plane of order q, NN^T=N^TN=(q mod 2)I+J follows directly from pairwise unique line intersections; v is odd so both possibilities are idempotent. F^4=F^2. Its periodic states are exactly im(F^2); the even/odd ranks, fixed spaces, Jordan block multiplicities and entry-depth cardinalities follow from invariant splitting and elementary rank-nullity. value.rationale: Finite projective-plane incidence graphs are a canonical connected regular family, and synchronous neighbor parity is a natural network dynamical rule. The result supplies an exact infinite-family recurrence/entry-depth classification (not isolated small-n enumeration), a sharp odd-versus-even transition from four recurrent states to 2^(2v-2), and a new dynamical operational interpretation of the plane-sensitive binary incidence rank. Non-Desarguesian cases matter precisely because their ranks may differ. The simple design identity is acknowledged as classical; the mathematical object, full orbit census and geometry-sensitive parameter dependence motivate the conclusion.
